description: This file defines a utility class 'BeanUtils' for working with JavaBeans, providing methods for creating instances and retrieving property values via reflection.

classes.name: BeanUtils
classes.description: A utility class for accessing properties of JavaBeans via reflection, including methods to instantiate and retrieve property values.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of BeanUtils.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from a given JavaBean object using reflection.

methods.name: getPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the PropertyDescriptor for a given property name from a JavaBean class.
